Done. All three functions implemented and exported:

1. **`clamp(n, min, max)`** — returns n limited to [min, max]
2. **`formatBytes(n)`** — formats bytes as human-readable string (B, KB, MB, GB) with one decimal place
3. **`loadSettings(filePath)`** — reads and parses JSON, applies defaults (theme: "dark", autosave: true), and throws clear errors with proper error codes

All error messages follow the project convention of starting with uppercase snake-case error codes.
